\caption{Document-pooled extraction scores on the same 157 documents containing
events out of the 167 validation set. The pooled columns count hazard-family
matches, normalised fuzzy location matches, and year-set date matches over
1{,}356 reference items (247 hazard, 683 location, 426 date). Acc.: percentage
of documents with no false positives or false negatives under these matching
rules; P: micro-precision; R: micro-recall; F1: micro-F1. The per-field columns
give micro-F1 for each component separately under its own matching rule ---
Haz.: hazard family; Loc-ex: exact location match after casefolding; Loc-fz:
fuzzy match at token-set ratio $\geq$ 90 on normalised strings, the rule the
pooled columns use; Date: year-set match, likewise the pooled rule. Loc-ex is
reported for contrast only and is not a pooled component; the Loc-fz minus
Loc-ex gap is what the matching rule concedes to surface-form variation, and at
GPT-5 mini (${+}40.2$\,pp) it exceeds the spread between most model pairs. All
scores are percentages. Bold indicates the highest value per column. False
positive and false negative rates are omitted because they are determined by
the columns shown: $100\,FP/(TP+FP) = 100 - P$ and $100\,FN/(TP+FN) = 100 - R$.}
\label{tab:validation-pooled}
